behavior: A part has one root node: its element, or one comment while it has no element. `Collapsible.Panel` and `Tabs.Indicator` are examples. `Toast.Viewport` keeps its sentinels in its element, and the script of `Tabs.Indicator` with `renderBeforeHydration` is the last child of its element. A rule of `<style scoped>`, `v-show`, a custom directive and a `<Transition>` of the developer thus apply to the element of the part. The root of `NavigationMenu.Content` is a `<Teleport>`, so a scoped rule, `v-show` and a directive of the developer do not reach its default element, and a `<Transition>` reaches it only from Vue 3.5.41. The `element` slot and the prop `transition` give them.
